blurb: At the Whitworth Ferguson Planetarium, immersive shows take students and guests on a journey through stars, planets, galaxies, and beyond. Our 48-seat, 35-foot dome - located in the Science and Mathematics Complex on Buffalo State University's campus - combines state-of-the-art software and projection systems to bring nearly any subject to life, from astronomy to music, art, wellness, and beyond.
